hazard_exposure.storm_rule: GDACS advisory pop39/pop74/popstormsurge preferred; polygon × GHSL is fallback when structured source exposure is unavailable. Orange/Red remain visible.
hazard_exposure.interpretation: Exposure is not observed harm, casualties, displacement, crop loss or economic loss.
hazard_exposure.fallback_population_dataset: JRC GHSL GHS-WUP-POP R2025A, epoch 2025, used only for Climate Pulse population fallback calculations
hazard_exposure.authority_policy: source-first: GDACS/GWIS structured modelled exposure first; Climate Pulse-derived metrics only as fallback or clearly labelled supplemental context
hazard_exposure.drought_rule: Use GDACS/GDO agricultural drought risk/impact information when published. Do not infer actual crop loss or affected population; derived land/forest/crop overlap is supplemental spatial context.
